text.description_html:
Inox MU-101-MA55-VH-32D, Universal Trim for Multipoint Locks with American Cylinder

MU Multipoint Trim with Cologne Lever American Cylinder Below Handle is designed to fit most patio doors with 3-5/8 inch (92mm) Lever-to-Lock Center Distance. INOX Universal Multipoint trim is designed with a patented adjustable thru-bolt system that allows it to retrofit with almost all multipoint locks and door prep configurations.

This multipoint trim set is intended to replace the trim from patio doors. The lock to lever distance is 3-5/8" (92 mm). This set does not come packaged with the multipoint lock mechanism (the vertical rods found in multipoint patio doors that secure the door to the frame) as those are typically preinstalled in multipoint doors and cannot be replaced.

Keyed Entry with American Cylinder: Active levers both sides of door. Keyed lock cylinder outside with thumb turn inside to lock door. Set includes: Two (2) backplates, Two (2) levers with spindles, One (1) american profile cylinder with key outside & thumbturn inside and mounting screws.

Features and Specifications of the Stainless Steel Modern MultiPoint Trim:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Trim Lever: 101 Cologne
  • Overall Height: 10-9/16"
  • Overall Width: 1-21/32"
  • Lever Length: 5-5/16"
  • Lever Width: 13/16"
  • Lever Projection: 2-7/16"
  • Distance Between Trim and Cylinder or Thumbturn: 3-5/8"
  • Plate Thickness: 7/16"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4" - 2-3/4" please specify.
  • Spindle: 8mm x 8mm square.
  • Handing: Choose outside handing.

Sold Individually
